criteria.text: Given a Bluesky doc row with `uri = "at://did:plc:x/app.bsky.feed.post/abc123"` and `domain = "ana.bsky.social"`, `renderDocBody` produces an `<a class="doc-link" href="https://bsky.app/profile/ana.bsky.social/post/abc123">` — verified manually in the browser per AC3 (no test harness covers `public/*.html`; see Test plan).
Given a Bluesky doc row with a uri that does not start with `at://`, or with `domain` null/empty/undefined, `renderDocBody` renders the row with no `<a class="doc-link">` element (same as today).

Manual check in the browser (`pnpm dev`, open a person with a Bluesky doc, e.g. `lula`): clicking `abrir ↗` on a Bluesky row opens the mapped `bsky.app` URL in a new tab (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`, already present).
No other source's row (`gnews`, `rss`, `gdelt`, `gkg`) changes behavior: rows that had a link before this change still have the same link; rows that had no link still have none.
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass unchanged (no `.ts` file is touched by this issue).
